name: Galaxy S4 Active

images.credit: Frmorrison, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: UMTS HSPA+ 900 (Band VIII), 2100 (Band I) MHz (not available in all markets), UMTS HSPA+ 850 (Band V), 1700 (Band IV), 1900 (Band II), 2100 (Band I) (not available in all markets) GSM GPRS/EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, LTE Cat 3 (Global LTE), LTE Cat 4 (South Korea)

Body.Dimensions: 5.5 in H, 2.80 in W, 0.35 in D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.2.2 "Jelly Bean" with TouchWiz Nature UX 2.0, Current: Android 5.0.1 "Lollipop" with TouchWiz Nature UX 4.0
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon 600 APQ8064 processor(Global), Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 MSM8974 Processor(South Korea)
Platform.CPU: 1.9 GHz Qualcomm Quad Core(Global), Qualcomm Krait 400 MP4 2.3 GHz (South Korea)

Memory.Card slot: up to 64 GB microSDHC (officially), up to 64 GB microSDXC (unofficially)

Display.Display: 5 in diagonal TFT, 1920x1080 px (~440 ppi) and Sony BRAVIA Engine 2 with scratch-resistant and shatterproof glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP (Global), 13 MP(South Korea) IMX135 Exmor RS back-side illuminated sensor with LED flash, 1080p video recording @ 30 frames/s 16x Digital Zoom

Battery.Battery: 2,600 mAh 13 hours talk time, 520 standby, removable

Connectivity.Connectivity: 4G LTE(100 Mbit/s) LTE (Bands 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 20), GPS, GLONASS, Micro USB 2.0, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC, UMTS HSPA+ (Bands 1, 3, 5, 8 or bands 1, 2, 4, 5, 8), Wi-Fi (802.11 ac/a/b/g/n), DLNA, GSM GPRS/EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, MHL
